lines.text: "description": "Commit baseRef resolved to when this document was written. refresh diffs from it."

lines.text: "description": "Commit headRef resolved to when this document was written. refresh diffs from it."

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: "description": "File name of the review this one was refreshed from, in the same directory. refresh writes it; the UI compares the two."

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: "description": "Short name of the whole change. Prefer a user-created title when it names this change."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: "description": "Short what of the whole change. Name the stories."

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: "description": "Generated why for the whole change, from tickets, issues, a request description, or a transcript. Cite sources with [text](source:id)."

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: "description": "Locators the skill read to write its prose. Ticket bodies, PR descriptions, and transcript text stay out. PR comment body is copied.",

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: "description": "Source verdicts: a source item done differently, not done, or not true at head, manual steps a source says the change needs, and instructions a source gives a reviewer. Cite the source.",

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: "description": "One entry per independent story when groups use part. name matches group part. summary is that story's one-sentence what.",

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: "description": "Short name of the independent story. Same string as group part."

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: "description": "One sentence: what this independent story is."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: "description": "Generated why this group exists. From a source when one applies, or that it enables later groups in the same story."

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: "description": "The one judgment call a reviewer makes in this group. Most groups have none.",

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: "description": "contract: a compatibility or API promise. tradeoff: a cost accepted for a gain. product: a product or scope call. risk: a risk accepted."

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: "description": "What the code at head does, where it matters, and the decision the reviewer makes."

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: "description": "At most 2 questions that ask why the change is this way, where the code and the sources leave the reason open. When a source answers one, the answer goes in why.",

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: "description": "Ranges the UI opens a hunk to. Each sits inside one live hunk of this group and spans at most 25 lines. The whole hunk is one click away.",

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: "description": "Git path of a file this group covers."

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: "description": "old: a line of the base file. new: a line of the head file."

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: "description": "Last line, inclusive. At most 25 lines from start."

lines.text: "description": "Line-anchored notes the UI letters A, B, C.",

lines.text: "description": "Git path of a file this group covers."

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: "description": "old: a line of the base file. new: a line of the head file."

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: "description": "1-based line on that side, inside a hunk this group covers."

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: "description": "What the code alone does not say about this line."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: "description": "Ids of earlier groups this one depends on. Same story only.",

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: "description": "Short name of the independent story this group belongs to. Same name = same story. Different names could have been separate PRs."

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: "description": "Ids of document sources this group names, even when the prose does not cite them inline.",

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: "description": "A git path (every live hunk of that file), a directory ending in / (every live hunk under it), or path@oldStart+newStart. A rename is old -> new@oldStart+newStart."

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: "description": "A path string covers every live hunk of that file. path@oldStart+newStart is one hunk. old -> new@oldStart+newStart is a renamed hunk."

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: "description": "Interpretation only: title, groups, summaries, and hunk pointers.",

lines.text: "description": "Short name shown in the UI. Examples: #24, alice on PR #32, Cursor session · Aug 12."

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: "description": "One or two sentences, written by the skill, saying why this source matters."

lines.text: "description": "Short name of the independent story this source belongs to. Same name as the groups in that story."
